lessons.title: Lesson #1
lessons.interactiveContent: Environment variables store important settings, like passwords or access keys, outside of your code, making them easier and safer to manage.

lessons.title: Lesson #2
lessons.interactiveContent:
Environment variables in Python let you safely set key-value pairs for your code. This is very handy for storing sensitive information.

Make sure to pick api_key, followed by api_key.

lessons.title: Lesson #1
lessons.interactiveContent:
Traditionally, developers used .env files to store environment variables.

However, more modern development environments, such as Mimo, provide a more user-friendly way to set up environment variables.

SECRET_KEY=mysecretkey.
